invariants.rationale: A new HashMap is always returned, regardless of if any parameters are added.
The only possible entry is inserted under PLAN_STRATEGY_SORT_COLUMNS.key().
If an entry exists, its value is from getWriteConfig().getClusteringSortColumns(), which is non-empty if present.
At most one parameter is ever put into the result map.
The map is non-empty iff clustering sort columns config is not empty.
